members.name: trigger
members.doc: The focusable element that opens the preview. Disabling the preview leaves it operable.

members.name: delay
members.doc: How long a hover waits before the preview opens, in milliseconds.

members.name: closeDelay
members.doc: How long the preview stays open after the pointer leaves, in milliseconds.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the preview is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the preview starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the preview: it does not open, and an open one closes. The trigger stays operable.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the preview opens against its trigger. start and end follow the locale direction.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the preview and its trigger, along the placement's side.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the preview is placed against.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the preview moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the preview and the edge of the viewport. Must not be negative.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Reports the preview opening or closing.

types.name: OverlayAccessibleName
